What the ten cards ask you to do on the next MRI list, one line from each. Each line opens its card.

    v10, 28 October 2026 · Created in BioRender. Sivasankara, G. (2026) BioRender.com

      Every number the cards state is held in a register with its source, the place in the source and what was read. Before any build, the derived numbers are recomputed from the sources' figures and the model's numbers from the field model; a build that disagrees with the register fails. The register follows, card by card.

      A teaching aid for the anaesthetist. Your unit's own MRI safety checks and the manufacturers' instructions decide what goes into the room.
